description: A read-only CSV viewer for quickly inspecting CSV and TSV files, including large ones.
config.initialRowCount: Number of rows shown when a file is opened. `All` shows every row. Applies to files opened after the change.
config.colorTheme: Color theme of the table. You can also change it from the toolbar. Applies to all open editors.
config.colorTheme.vscode: Follow the colors of the VS Code theme, without an accent color.
